evidence.reason: The marker is created with O_CREAT|O_EXCL and the file contents are fsynced, but the parent directory entry is never fsynced. File fsync alone does not durably persist the new directory entry, so a power loss after acquire can reboot without the admission hold despite the code claiming the token is persisted. The same durability gap applies to removal on release (line 459), where an unsynced unlink can leave a stale hold after reboot. This is an implementation error in the intended crash-safe admission behavior, and the smallest fix is to fsync the marker directory after creation and after removal, reporting a verification failure if either sync fails.
